title: Determinism and replay
preamble:
# Determinism and replay

What an integrator needs to know to get **deterministic replay** out of libds:
the determinism guarantee and its scope, the platform signature that bounds it,
and the event-trace session header that identifies a recording. This is the
integrator-facing slice; the normative guarantee is the language spec's
([LDET]).

## What this is not

- Not the determinism contract — see [LDET].
- Not the event-trace wire format — see [RFCS] and [LFST].
